# Repository layout

Every path docs-kit reads or writes in a consumer repository, relative to the
repository root.

## Ownership

| Kind | Written by | Checked by `check` | Edit by hand |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Generated** | `refresh` (and `init` the first time) | yes | never |
| **Scaffold** | `init` only; skipped when identical, refused when changed (unless `--force`) | no | yes, it is yours |
| **Input** | you, or your export task | no | yes |
| **Local** | `init`, `build`, `serve` | no | not committed |

## Generated files

| Path | Pipeline | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cli/<bin>.usage.kdl` | CLI | the CLI code (`spec`) + `cli/<bin>.usage.extra.kdl` | Typer: regenerated by `refresh`, compared by `check`. Go: regenerated by your `cli:spec` task |
| `docs/references/cli/<bin>.md` | CLI | `cli/<bin>.usage.kdl` via `usage generate markdown` | starts with a `<!-- generated by docs-kit … -->` banner |
| `docs/reference/openapi.json` | API | `openapi.json` | byte-exact copy |
| `docs/reference/swagger.html` | API | template | Swagger UI, loaded from jsDelivr |
| `docs/references/api.md` | API | template | embeds `swagger.html` |
| `docs/references/endpoints.md` | API | `openapi.json` | sorted endpoint and schema tables |
| `.github/workflows/docs.yml` | GitHub only | template | `ref:` stamped with the CLI version |
| `mise.toml` / `.mise.toml`, between `# --- docs-kit tasks v… ---` markers | dependency mode | CLI version + detected pipelines | only the marked block; the rest of the file is yours |

## Scaffold files

| Path | Written when |
| --- | --- |
| `zensical.toml` | always |
| `docs/index.md` | always |
| `docs/references/cli-standard.md` | a CLI is detected |

## Inputs

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `openapi.json` (or `--spec PATH`) | turns the API pipeline on |
| `cli/<bin>.usage.extra.kdl` | hand-written nodes merged into the contract: `config`, `exit_code`, `example`, `output`, `complete`, `version`, `cmd <path> { … }` |
| `cli/<bin>.usage.kdl` without a generator | hand-written contract (recipe `kdl`) |
| `pyproject.toml` | Typer detection |
| `go.mod` | cobra detection |

## Local files

`init` adds these to `.gitignore`:

| Path | Added in | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `site/` | every mode | output of `build` |
| `.cache/` | every mode | Zensical cache |
| `mise.local.toml` | `--with-mise` | shim mode: the opt-in block; dependency mode: your overrides |
| `.docs-kit/` | `--with-mise` without `--committed` | the task layer: sparse checkout of `shared/mise/` at tag `v<version>` |

## Detection

| Pipeline | Active when | Recipe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| API | `openapi.json` exists (or `--spec` names a file), and no `--no-api` | – |
| CLI | `pyproject.toml` depends on `typer` and declares `[project.scripts]` | `python`, app `<pkg>.cli:app` |
| CLI | `go.mod` requires `github.com/spf13/cobra` | `go`, named after the module's last path segment |
| CLI | `cli/<bin>.usage.kdl` is committed | `kdl` |
| CLI | `--bin NAME` | `unknown` unless one of the above matches |
| GitHub workflow | `.github/workflows/` exists, `$GITHUB_REPOSITORY` is set, or `.git/config` mentions `github.com` | – |

`--no-cli` disables every CLI row. `init` refuses to run when no pipeline is
active.
